channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen’s Taiz under siege again as food and fuel prices rise
item.description: Houthi advances and the closure of vital roads into Taiz have triggered shortages, reviving memories of earlier siege.

item.title: Hours after Trump-Putin diesel deal, Ukraine strikes Russian fuel site
item.description: Ukraine bombed a Russian fuel site, hours after US President Trump and Russian President Putin announced a diesel deal.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump vows to quickly ‘settle or win’ Iran and Ukraine wars
item.description: Trump says that he expects to soon “settle or win” the conflicts involving Iran and Russia-Ukraine.

item.title: UN envoy warns Yemen has returned to ‘full-scale war’, urges dialogue
item.description: Saudi Arabia and Yemen's internationally recognised gov't urge UN Security Council action amid Houthi escalation.

item.title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
item.description: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.

item.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
item.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.
